description: This file defines types, functions, and state management for a memory plugin system, including prompt building, flush plan resolution, and runtime management.

classes.name: MemoryPromptSectionBuilder
classes.description: Type for a function that builds a memory prompt section based on available tools and citations mode.

classes.name: MemoryFlushPlan
classes.description: Type representing a plan for flushing memory, including token thresholds and prompts.

classes.name: MemoryFlushPlanResolver
classes.description: Type for a function that resolves a MemoryFlushPlan based on configuration and current time.

classes.name: RegisteredMemorySearchManager
classes.description: Type for managing memory search operations, including status checks, embedding and vector availability probes, synchronization, and closing.

classes.name: MemoryRuntimeQmdConfig
classes.description: Configuration type for QMD backend runtime.

classes.name: MemoryRuntimeBackendConfig
classes.description: Union type for backend configuration, either 'builtin' or 'qmd'.

classes.name: MemoryPluginRuntime
classes.description: Type for the runtime interface managing memory search managers and backend configuration.

classes.name: MemoryPluginState
classes.description: Internal state object holding optional prompt builder, flush plan resolver, and runtime.

methods.name: registerMemoryPromptSection
methods.description: Registers a prompt section builder function.

methods.name: buildMemoryPromptSection
methods.description: Builds a memory prompt section using the registered builder.

methods.name: getMemoryPromptSectionBuilder
methods.description: Retrieves the current prompt section builder.

methods.name: registerMemoryFlushPlanResolver
methods.description: Registers a flush plan resolver function.

methods.name: resolveMemoryFlushPlan
methods.description: Resolves and returns a memory flush plan based on parameters.

methods.name: getMemoryFlushPlanResolver
methods.description: Retrieves the current flush plan resolver.

methods.name: getMemoryRuntime
methods.description: Retrieves the current memory plugin runtime.

methods.name: hasMemoryRuntime
methods.description: Checks if a memory runtime is registered.

methods.name: restoreMemoryPluginState
methods.description: Restores plugin state from a given state object.

methods.name: _resetMemoryPluginState
methods.description: Alias for clearMemoryPluginState, resets plugin state.
